item.description:

LanguageHindi

Release Date06 Nov 2026

NOTICE is an emotional drama that captures the struggles and pain of an ordinary man, portraying a courageous and truly motivational journey in the fight for justice. The story centers on a 150-year-old shop threatened by development. An ordinary man, played by Arun Govil, takes on a corrupt system to save the shop, while his wife, played by Dipika Chikhlia, stands by him through the struggle.

item.title: [Hindi] [OTT Release] Haiwaan
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageHindi
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date06 Nov 2026 (OTT)

A remake of the 2016 Malayalam film 'Oppam', 'Haiwaan' is a suspense thriller that revolves around a visually impaired man who works as a lift operator in a residential building. He finds himself as the prime suspect in a murder that takes place in one of the apartments. He must now race against time to find the real killer and protect a young girl from the relentless and psychotic murderer.
